name: P-005 / R-10 live stranded-blocked reading on the operator database (event-wait-settlement-2026-10-20)
summary: The R-10 probe (docs/evidence/ews-p005-r10-stranded-live/probe.sql) read the re-check sweep's own population on papercusp-workspace and returned 17|6|11|0|0|0|249|8: 17 blocked item(s) with every blocker cleared = 6 re-blocked after the clear + 11 under another hold + 0 stranded + 0 cleared since the last completed tick + 0 with unknown times; the sweep host routine last started 249s before the reading and the repair path has written 8 audit row(s). The committed oracle judged it PASS. All five negative controls failed on their targeted assertion as required.

assertions.evidence: gate-watcher-tick last started 249s ago (limit 900s; -1 = routine row missing); row 17|6|11|0|0|0|249|8
reblocked_after_clear=6 + other_hold=11 + stranded=0 + cleared_since_tick=0 + missing_times=0 = 17; all_cleared_blocked=17; row 17|6|11|0|0|0|249|8
stranded=0 (blocked, every blocker cleared before the last completed tick, no other hold); row 17|6|11|0|0|0|249|8
one synthetic local candidate, cleared a day before the tick, no hold keys: the falsifier must fire; row 18|6|11|1|0|0|249|8; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: no-stranded-item

a stranded candidate whose origin and hold keys are all absent (NULL): it must still be counted stranded, not dropped from every bucket; row 18|6|11|1|0|0|249|8; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: no-stranded-item
a candidate with no state_changed_at: an unclassifiable row must fail rather than pass silently; row 18|6|11|0|0|1|249|8; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: no-unknown-times
the sweep routine last start moved a day back: a stopped sweep must not read as nothing stranded; row 17|6|11|0|0|0|86650|8; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: sweep-is-live
the repair actor renamed to one that never wrote: a build without the repair path must fail; row 17|6|11|0|0|0|250|0; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: repair-path-observed

environment.reader: sudo -n -u postgres psql -q -At (BEGIN READ ONLY ... ROLLBACK)

limitations: One live reading, not a continuous observation: an item can be stranded and repaired between readings.

The reading judges the outcome (no item left stranded past a tick), not the sweep code path; the code path is covered by the tree evidence bound to the same clause (work-item-blocker-reaper.integration.test.ts and its mutation run).

Supersedes docs/evidence/ews-p005-r10-stranded-blocked-live.sql: that query classified with independent FILTERs whose hold flags could be NULL, so a stranded row with no needsOwnerAction key would have counted in no bucket. Its 2026-10-21T01:59Z reading still partitioned exactly (19 = 6 + 13 + 0 + 0), so that reading is unaffected; this probe closes the hole structurally and control-null-flags proves it.

instrument.role: Every pass/fail decision on the probe rows is taken by this committed oracle; run.mjs only executes the SQL and records output.
